capabilities: Stamp start/done/cancelled times on the line
Configure the state cycle, symbols and marks
extras: Checkbox clicks are handled in the capture phase and conflict with other checkbox-handling plugins such as Tasks; turn them off when using those. Checkbox styles are off by default so they do not override themes or CSS snippets. Install via BRAT (issei10/obsidian-task-trail).
intentEvidence: Click a checkbox to move the task to its next state
problem: Obsidian checkboxes only track to-do and done, with no record of when a task started, finished or was dropped.

relations.evidence: the same emoji as the start and done dates of the Tasks plugin

summary: Checkbox state cycler that stamps the time each task is started, finished or dropped, cycling through configurable states.
